description: This is a PHP class defining a validation rule for image aspect ratios within the OrangeHRM project, specifically used for validating images during corporate branding customization.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatio
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an input image conforms to a specified aspect ratio, ignoring SVG images.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with the expected aspect ratio.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input image data to ensure it matches the specified aspect ratio, with special handling for SVG images.
